name: mook-levels
description: A level-based world-map edition of Mook

scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && env LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 cap sync ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.test: npm run test:gameplay && npm run test:release-identity && npm run test:v1.1-native
